sections.heading: Pitch Overview
sections.text: Prepared on 19 October 2025, pitch SYN-SYNCP000064-P1 was put before Pioneer Family Clinic 064 on behalf of PFIZER.

sections.heading: Put Forward in Exchange
sections.text: In exchange the Supplier put forward a Band 1 rebate of 2.5 per cent.

sections.heading: Sought in Return
sections.text: The Supplier sought a yearly Pneumococcal minimum take of 230 doses in return.

sections.heading: Recorded Result
sections.text: Recorded result: the Customer has not yet responded.
